description: Global Electrification Platform (GEP) Application is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). The Global Electrification Platform (GEP) is an open-access, open-resource, online platform that explores options for achieving universal electrification for the countries with greatest electrification deficits globally. Entire dataset, documentation, and application can be found here. Coverage: 59 countries. It has 3 files in HTML, ZIP, GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
